architecture: MLP 1f: Linear(1,32), ReLU, Identity (no dropout), Linear(32,32), ReLU, Linear(32,1)
input_processing: Original signed midpoint distance divided by first recorded value; negative distances preserved, no clipping or absolute value; no secondary input scaling
training: Current implementation: shuffle trial order; one Adam step per complete trial; equal trial mean absolute loss; lr=0.001, weight_decay=0.0001
selection: Fixed 400 epochs; last epoch saved; no Test used for fitting, tuning, or epoch selection
window: Only current signed-distance ratio is input, shape(N,1), no history or padding. For a controlled window-length comparison, fitting and main metrics retain the original5f eligible target frames. Separate full predictions start at the first valid frame.
split: Exact38/17 names, order, main target frames and target scaler from signed-px baseline; input window reduced5to1, no dropout
diagnostic_scope: Same data, split, main target frames, scaler, seed and optimizer settings; current-frame input only, no dropout. First layer is1to32 rather than5to32, so initialization cannot be identical across input shapes. 400 fixed epochs; final weights saved, no Test selection.
